mechanism: Vedolizumab causes selective immunosuppression of gut-homing lymphocytes, which may theoretically reduce gastrointestinal adverse effects from liraglutide but increases infection risk; liraglutide may impair immune function through GLP-1 receptor effects on immune cells.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and gastrointestinal tolerability; no dose adjustment required, but consider baseline immune status and maintain appropriate vaccinations before vedolizumab initiation.
